name: skillosophy
description: Start Codex projects with a working philosophy, relevant practical and reasoning skills, specialist role instructions, and project-local skill installation.

interface.longDescription: Before building, clarify the project goals and working approach, choose a small set of practical and reasoning skills, define specialist roles, and install selected skills into the project. Includes original workflows, philosopher lenses, and pinned upstream skill sources. Roles are instructions; installation does not launch agents or configure services.
interface.defaultPrompt: Prepare this Codex project: determine its working philosophy, select useful skills, and install them with specialist roles.

publication.release_notes: Prepare Skillosophy for public distribution with project-start onboarding, practical and philosophical skill selection, project-local installation, and specialist role instructions. Installer checks and initial philosopher evaluations are documented separately; broad AI performance improvement has not been established.

review.commerce_description: Skillosophy is free and does not sell products or process payments. Third-party services may have their own fees.
